intro: The Deathstalker Report is a written dispatch penned by Deathstalker Rane Yorick detailing military reconnaissance in Silverpine Forest. It contains critical tactical intelligence intended for High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher regarding local Scourge movements and the state of the Forsaken's forward scouts.

p: Reconnaissance in northern Silverpine Forest is a lethal duty, even for the undead. After finding themselves ambushed and pinned down by Scourge prowling the pine woods, Deathstalkers Rane Yorick and Quinn Yorick had to consolidate their findings into this hurried dispatch. The report summarizes unexpected levels of Scourge resistance threatening Forsaken territorial ambitions in the region. Because Quinn suffered grievous injuries during their mission, the document is entrusted to passing allies to ensure High Executor Hadrec receives word at the Sepulcher without delay.
